svg.title: Terraform Lab 08 — Site-to-site IPsec VPN with BGP
svg.desc: IPsec encrypts the path; BGP runs inside the tunnel so each side learns the other's prefixes dynamically
svg.text: Terraform Lab 08 — Site-to-site IPsec VPN with BGP
IPsec encrypts the path; BGP runs inside the tunnel so each side learns the other's prefixes dynamically
HOW THE TUNNEL COMES UP · IN ORDER
UDP 500/4500: peers authenticate with the pre-shared key
ESP tunnel up between the two public IPs
forward AND return route are required
tunnel up but no ping? BGP not Established, a missing
return route, or a firewall blocking 10.1.0.0/16 in GCP
